disposition_reason: Original AAS measurements of cadmium and lead in street-vended fried spiced meat made from cattle, sheep, goat, dog and chicken meat in Kaduna, Nigeria.

study.market: Suya spots across Chikun, Igabi, Kaduna North and Kaduna South LGAs (e.g. Ungwan Sarki, Kawo, Sabon Tasha, Barnawa), Kaduna Metropolis, Nigeria
study.method: Oven-dried at 45 °C, dry-ashed at 500 °C, HNO3 then HCl dissolution; flame AAS (Shimadzu AA-6800)

regulatory_or_exposure.what: Limits cited by authors (FAO 1983 / EC): lead 0.01 µg/g and cadmium 0.003 µg/g, as printed

unresolved: Sample count is inconsistent: 50 in the abstract and methods, n = 46 in Tables 2-4, and Table 1 totals 92 (appears double-counted).
Species means in the abstract and results text differ slightly from Table 3 (e.g. cattle Pb 0.47 vs 0.46); table values were recorded.
Results basis (dry vs as sold) is not stated; samples were dried before ashing.
No LOD, CRM or recovery data reported; collection dates not reported.
